title: Declared rate-limit budgets and bounded retry sharing the limiter

outcomes.statement: Requests are held to the declared per-endpoint budgets and retries are bounded and counted against the same budget, so a retry storm cannot exceed the ceiling.
outcomes.demo: With an injected clock, a burst past 100/min user management is deferred rather than issued; a retry sequence provably cannot exceed the declared per-minute ceiling; a Retry-After header is honored.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Scope is deterministic fixtures backed by Pact consumer contracts. Live acceptance stays gated behind the authorized provider run named in the parent story's AC4.

uncertainties.statement: AC1 is a single criterion covering both credential separation and rate limiting, so this child alone does not satisfy it.
uncertainties.resolution: AC1 is satisfied only when US-059 and US-060 have both landed. Closing this child on its own must not be read as meeting AC1; the sibling carries the other half.

uncertainties.statement: No rate-limit or retry machinery exists anywhere in the workspace, and packages/connectors declares zero runtime dependencies.
uncertainties.resolution: Hand-roll the limiter against an injected clock, keeping the package dependency-free and the tests deterministic. This is the greenfield work that forced the US-056 partition.

uncertainties.statement: Retry must not amplify load against a rate-limited provider.
uncertainties.resolution: Retries draw from the same limiter as first attempts, asserted by a test proving a retry storm cannot exceed the declared ceiling.

uncertainties.statement: The declared limits are documented values, not measured.
uncertainties.resolution: Encoded as configuration (100/min user management, 60/min analytics, 1200 invites/hour) and asserted against fixtures. Confirming real provider behavior belongs to the gated live run.
